cd /work && grep -n -E '^error|^test result|^==|FAILED' tmp/gate.log | head -70 && cat crate/src/compiler.rs crate/src/loader.rs crate/src/executor.rs && cat crate/src/run.rs && ls crate/tests && find crate/book -maxdepth 2 -type f | head -40

cd /work && sed -n '185,230p' tmp/gate.log && sed -n '2090,2188p' tmp/gate.log && cat crate/src/analyzer.rs | head -280 && cat crate/src/evaluator.rs | head -360 && cat crate/src/unresolved_recipe.rs && cat crate/src/recipe_resolver.rs

cd /work && ./run sh -c 'cd /work/crate && cargo build --locked --bin just' > /work/tmp/build.log 2>&1 && tail -6 tmp/build.log && cat crate/tests/datetime.rs && grep -n -E 'function|recursion|depth|format_string' crate/src/parser.rs | head -65 && cat crate/src/justfile.rs | head -250 && cat crate/src/ran.rs

cd /work && ls -la && ls crate/target/debug/just && sed -n '590,690p' crate/src/parser.rs && cat crate/src/unindent.rs && cat crate/src/command_ext.rs && cat crate/src/execution_context.rs && cat crate/src/scope.rs
cd /work && ./run sh -c 'cd /work/crate && cargo build --locked --bin just --target-dir /work/tmp/target' > /work/tmp/build-local.log 2>&1
cd /work && sed -n '590,690p' crate/src/parser.rs && cat crate/src/unindent.rs && cat crate/src/command_ext.rs && cat crate/src/execution_context.rs && cat crate/src/scope.rs

cd /work && cat > tmp/probe.py <<'PY'
import os, pathlib, subprocess
BASE=pathlib.Path('/work/tmp/probes'); BASE.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
BIN='/work/tmp/target/debug/just'
def probe(name,files,args):
 p=BASE/name; p.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
 for n,s in files.items():
  dest=p/n; dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True); dest.write_text(s)
 try:
  r=subprocess.run([BIN,'--unstable','--justfile',str(p/'justfile'),*args],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=4,cwd=p)
  print(name, 'status',r.returncode,'stdout',repr(r.stdout[:1500]),'stderr',repr(r.stderr[:1500]),flush=True)
 except subprocess.TimeoutExpired: print(name,'TIMEOUT',flush=True)
probe('datetime',{'justfile':"x := datetime('%Q')
"},['--evaluate','x'])
probe('datetime-utc',{'justfile':"x := datetime_utc('%')
"},['--evaluate','x'])
probe('func-override',{'justfile':"x := 'original'
f() := x
a := f()
"},['--evaluate','x=override','a'])
probe('func-cycle',{'justfile':"x := f()
f() := x
"},['--evaluate','x'])
probe('func-recursive',{'justfile':"f() := f()
x := f()
"},['--evaluate','x'])
probe('mod-shared',{'justfile':"mod a 'shared.just'
mod b 'shared.just'
",'shared.just':"show:
 @echo {{module_path()}}
"},['a::show','b::show'])
probe('mod-relative',{'justfile':"mod a './a.just'
",'a.just':"show:
 @echo {{module_path()}}
"},['a::show'])
probe('mod-mutual',{'justfile':"mod a
mod b
",'a.just':"mod b 'b.just'
",'b.just':"mod a 'a.just'
"},['--summary'])
probe('func-lazy',{'justfile':"set lazy
x := 'original'
f() := x
show:
 @echo {{f()}}
"},['x=override','show'])
probe('func-export',{'justfile':"export X := 'hello'
f() := `printf '%s' "$X"`
x := f()
"},['--evaluate','x'])
PY
./run python3 /work/tmp/probe.py
